notes.title: Dev log: Squad Showdown, New Mechanics, & So, So Much More!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the biggest content drop Setback has seen in forever![/h2]

Setback is still in development and far from release, but this weekend we invite you to playtest a number of new features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/0ff76c22808bdd8cbb14e24bc05bcff489f70464.png[/img]

[h2]Squad Showdown![/h2]
This Sunday the Squad Showdown goes down! Sign up from the Event Page in the playtest and compete for money, fame, and glory!

The tournament starts on Sunday at 18:00 CEST and lasts for 3 hours. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/6BNRQggTES]community discord[/url] for more info

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/05afa3d1eae1862a8a78f79f67185561a9312b96.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/0ff76c22808bdd8cbb14e24bc05bcff489f70464.png[/img]

[h2]Wall Running![/h2]
This mechanic has been a long time coming and we've finally gotten to the point where we can start working on it. This is still a very early version of Wall Running, and it is going to change a lot in the future, but we've had too much fun with this early version of the mechanic as is, so even if it's far from finished we just couldn't keep ourselves from adding it to the Public Playtest so you can join in on the parkour goodness.

Along with this change air resistance has been increased at very high speeds, forcing players to continuously work for their momentum, instead of just coasting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/cc7ea9288dff90e71f2f396b10dc22230e35f7c5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/0ff76c22808bdd8cbb14e24bc05bcff489f70464.png[/img]

[h2]Bring on the Hurricane![/h2]
Earlier this week our lead developer accidentally broke and destroyed the Gravity Well by accidentally flipping the gravitational force it inflicts. The result was a field that shot people into the air. The entire dev team thought this was so god damn funny that they approached me, Oliver, the master of FX, and author of this dev log, and our lead dev commanded (menacingly) "Oliver, by the end of the day you will make us a Tornado effect, a glorious Tornado the likes of which the world has ever seen, so we can use it to turn this mess of a bug into a real item". And that, dear reader, is the story of how the Tornado was born.

But what is the Tornado? The Tornado is a throw-able projectile that summons a slow moving, short lived tornado field that sends all who enter flying into the air.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/31c532746ef992e8baeb80191296740df05492e4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/0ff76c22808bdd8cbb14e24bc05bcff489f70464.png[/img]

[h2]New Game Mode: Flag Point![/h2]
Flag Point is an asymetrical game mode where one team attacks and the other defends!

In Flag Point the attacking team competes to guard and transport its team's flag through a series of checkpoints, scoring points as they can before the time runs out, while the defending team tries to thwart their efforts at all cost. When the time is out, or if the attacking team clears the entire course, the roles are switched, giving both teams the chance to play both roles.

The team that cleared the most checkpoints, wins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/0fdd93776c3d89cec8043c2f4d7c760efb4c9ae3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/0ff76c22808bdd8cbb14e24bc05bcff489f70464.png[/img]

[h2]I'm Not Losing, I'm Falling Back in Time with Style![/h2]
The First Person Effect for being setbacked has recieved a complete redesign, with a much more Setback themed style. We know that the beauty of the new effect can make it tempting to lose intentionally, but try to remember the tale of Narcissus, and stay clear of mortal harm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/d8c6b316b7cca6ad7a564420da7fd450bd7f02ca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/0ff76c22808bdd8cbb14e24bc05bcff489f70464.png[/img]

[h2]Setback for Nerds (Who Like to Read)[/h2]
Have you ever played Setback and felt overwhelmed? Surprised? Confused even? Well fret not, we've added an encyclopedia with info on all of Setback's items and weapons that you can read to your heart's content. In the future the encyclopedia will be expanded to include info about maps, game modes, cake recipes (maybe), and more!

Just keep an eye out for this symbol on the main menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/c1f6c9c7892a6eec0877c49c26695dd091e28ff9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/0ff76c22808bdd8cbb14e24bc05bcff489f70464.png[/img]

[h2]A Myriad of Item Changes![/h2]
A number of smaller changes to Items has been made as well for improved quality of life, and game balance!

- Target Items such as the Gravity Well and Orbital Strike have been reworked into projectile items that deploy where the projectile lands. This change was made to move away from the targeting system of the Target Items, as it never looked good, and often caused game breaking bugs.
- The Molotime Cocktail has been nerfed drastically, reaffirming its role as an item that is supposed to lock off an area, instead of straight up being a high damage menace.
- The Jelly Bomb has been buffed with an increased blast radius to make it more effective as a crowd control item. The Jelly Bomb has always been effective as a movement tool, but its crowd control prowess have always been lacking, making this a much needed buff.

notes.title: Dream Hack Patch Notes 2: Versus Event!
notes.content:
[h1]Versus Event[/h1] 
A new competition has started in Setback: Versus Battle! During this event three teams will compete to decide which brew is the best: Coffee, Tea, or Water. To join the versus event download the Seteback demo and head to the events tab in the main menu where you can choose your team! Winning a game earns 3 points for your team while playing any game wins 1 point for your team!

Depending on the team you chose you will unlock a water, tea, or coffee themed t-shirt! The team that wins the overall event will have a skin made themed around that drink ☕🧋💧

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1001683704965500970/1144310647862087751/Versus_Battle.png?width=1193&height=671[/img]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Molotime Cocktail reduced from 20 seconds to 10 seconds.
[*] Capture the flag UI changed to better communicate the status of flags
[*] Added hover text to clarify when you can pick up the flag
[*] Team related colors added to score board
[*] Capture the flag (one flag) removed from rotation
[*] Crazy zones removed from rotation
[*] We have now added a very short immunity window and full health restore after picking up a flag. 
[*] Towers map readded into map rotation
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed loading into a lobby and not being assigned to a team
[*] Fixed a bug that caused you to go back to the main menu after getting past the loading screen when in a party
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Flag disappearing
[*] Occasional bug that causes you to not be able to shoot or use items after attempting to use projectile item
[*] In very specific situations the UI for Victory versus Defeat can be attributed incorrectly
[/list]

notes.title: Setback DreamHack Indie Showcase Patch Notes 1
notes.content:
In this patch we go over some bugs, bug fixes, and new content! 

[h2]CRAZY ZONES[/h2]
Introducing Crazy Zones! Crazy Zones is a fun alteration to the existing game mode Safe Zone. Just like safe zone you want to be inside the zone when the timer goes down but this time the zones have wacky attributes to make it extra challenging. You'll have to think on your feet and approach each zone with a different strategy if you hope to win! 

Crazy Zones features the following zones:
[list]
[*] Safe Zone: Normal zone
[*] Gravity-Free Zone: No gravity inside the zone
[*] Speed Zone: Speed boost inside the zone
[*] Danger Zone: Damage inside the zone
[*] Fake Zone: A zone you can't enter, hidden among them is one normal safe zone
[/list]

[previewyoutube=nrAQpGyjXvw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the height of the flag and base indicators so they don’t overlap as much
[*] Added new game mode: Crazy Zones
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Items added to a few maps missing items
[*] Fixed Flag race not ending unless team 1 got 2 points
[*] Fixed being able to finish the race multiple times for match points letting you win best of 3 in one round
[*] Fixed visuals and sound prompting through checkpoints after the race ended
[*] Fixed flag race announcement showing multiple times equal to the round number
[*] Fixed bot names changing between rounds
[*] Rocket being shot down but still damaging the player
[*] Fixed a bug that chose a random winner when 2 teams reached match point
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Investigating an issue that causes players to return to the main menu after getting past the loading screen. This seems to only happen when in a squad so the temporary fix is to que at the same time as your friends. 
[*] We're aware of a issue where you may join a lobby as a player or spectator but not be assigned to a team. 
[*] Enemy flag not respawning 
[*] Throwable items can sometimes make bots teleport beneath the floor 
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog - Two New Items and Moving Forward (literally)
notes.content:
[h1]Hi![/h1]
We're one month into the new year and we've been hard at work, when this post goes live, so will a new public playtest, and this playtest will be the debut of two new items: The Orbital Strike, and the Gravity Well.

[h1]New Items[/h1]
[h2]Orbital Strike[/h2]
The Orbital Strike is a threat worth respecting. Aim and fire to place a target for the strike to hit. Anyone brave (dumb) enough to stick around will be hit by the unyielding force of space and time crashing in from above.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/ffa284cd86ee9442f316928fa023ed223948ce33.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gravity Well[/h2]
Take a knee as you're crushed under the unbearable weight of the gravity well. Do you like freely moving along the Z axis? Well too bad nerd. Anyone or anything caught in the gravity will come crashing down to earth and get stunned when they hit the ground. Need to make a grand escape? Cross a gap and use a Gravity Well to block your opponents from following you over it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/527419249306f0b1c9380271869b1b0dad1e7d55.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's that? It looks like your cardio has been paying off![/h1]
We're currently in the middle of reworking several aspects of Setback's movement. This means several new mechanics, as well as revamps of existing mechanics. One notable change is that our target movement system doesn't use stamina.

So for now, while we move towards our new movement, we've decided to turn off stamina. This means there's no reason to not just sprint all the time, but oh well.

[h1]Please Wishlist[/h1]
Seriously, it means a lot. How much? Well from now on, anyone with Setback on their wishlist will receive a permanent +20% XP boost. You're welcome, shake my hand.



Your's truly,

Oliver M. B. Nakken

Leading Game Designer
Riddlebit Software

notes.title: We invite you to a very spooky demo
notes.content:
Setback will be celebrating Halloween with a very spooky demo 👻

Throughout Scream Fest Setback will be transformed into a haunted version of itself with a frightening new game mode, creepy cosmetics, and horrifying new maps! 

[h1] Horde Mode 🧟[/h1]
Evil robots have begun spawning from the ground with a taste for man flesh! They have varying attributes, grow in number, and are dying to sink their robot claws into the nearest human. 

No one knows the cause of the Setbot's corruption, but one thing is certain: [b][i]Trust no one[/i][/b]. This is not your typical band together to fight the zombies game mode, rather players will need to sabotage and back stab their way to the top. Work together if you must, but in the end only one player will remain 😈 

[h1] Corrupted Maps & Spooktacular Skins 🎃 [/h1]

Terrify the competition with some creepy new cosmetics! 

With an evil robot invasion comes a new evil map! Get in the Halloween spirit with eerie decorations at every turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/e1624256cbc5eff44f29ccd767ee3327215f0e56.png[/img]

notes.title: Next Fest Full Devlog: Play, Customize, & Progress Together
notes.content:
[h1]Setback All Week Long[/h1]

🎉Setback is participating in Steam Next Fest from Oct.3rd- Oct. 10th🎉

For the first time Setback will be playable for an entire week. We've heard the feedback from our fantastic playtesters and the team has been hard at work integrating your feedback along with a host of other updates in time for Next Fest.

If you've participated in our playtests before, get ready for a whole new experience 🎮

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] Customizable Human Characters
[*] Returning Game Mode: Safe Zone
[*] Leaderboards
[*] Squads: Queue With Your Friends
[*] Requeue: Instantly Join A New Game of Setback After Elimination
[*] Progression System
[*] Bots
[*] New Maps
[*] New Cosmetics
[/list]

[h2]Humanity Arrives[/h2]
It may surprise you to learn that Setback was never intended to be a game about robots. While the robots will always hold a special place in our hearts, it's high time for humanity to make its entrance into the world of Setback. 

Make it personal by customizing your Setback athlete. Setback now has human character models with customizable gender, skin color, and cosmetics!

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1008659254430933025/1026209197911724032/Human_Character_1.png?width=1581&height=889[/img]

[h2]Returning Game Mode: Safe Zone[/h2]
Safe Zone is returning as a playable game mode alongside Bomb Tag. In Safe zone you must fight against other players to stay withing designate green safe zones while a timer slowly ticks down. When the timer reaches zero, anyone outside of the safe zone is eliminated.

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1008659254430933025/1026210344785432586/safezonedevlog.jpg[/img]

[h2]Leaderboards[/h2]
Setback now has leaderboards. No more claiming you're the best Setbacker around, you can finally prove it! 

[h2]Requeue: Join A New Game of Setback After Elimination[/h2]

As fun as it is to sit back for a minute and watch a match unfold, we recognize that sometimes you just want to jump right into a new game. After being eliminated you can now immediately jump into a new game of Setback. 

[h2]Squads: Queue With Your Friends[/h2]
The ability to queue up and play with your friends has been a long requested feature. We're happy to announce that you can finally invite up to 8 of your friends through steam to join you in Setback. 

When in a squad only the party leader will be able to start the queue. If you are eliminated early in a match, you can either spectate until the beginning of the new round or leave the squad and requeue alone. 

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1008659254430933025/1026221660577206272/HighresScreenshot00099.png?width=1643&height=890[/img]

[h2]Progression System [/h2]
It's important to us that players are properly rewarded for their playtime and growing skill. With that in mind we have integrated a progresssion system. After each match, you are granted cash based on your playtime and placement in the match. Besides bragging about how rich you are, this cash can be used to buy cosmetics (clothes and emotes) in the main menu. 

[h2]Bots[/h2]
We love are Setback robots (Setbots as we call them) and with the introduction of Humanity we didn't want them to fade into history. Our Setbots are now used as bots that will fill the missing amount of players during matches. The Setbots aren't used to their new role yet and as such they aren't the smartest robots out there. We will continue to fine tune them as Setback develops.  

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1008659254430933025/1026220801801867274/botvhuman2.png[/img]

[h2]New Maps[/h2]
We will have a variety of rotating maps during Steam Next Fest. Some new, some updated. Play Setback to try them out for yourself and leave your feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/rtEg52gVzc]Discord[/url]!

[h2]New Cosmetics[/h2]
Use your hard earned Setbucks to purchase a wide variety of cosmetics. Need a new tophat? How about some stylish shoes? Deck out your Setback athlete and style on your opponents. 

[h2]Help us improve Setback[/h2]
This week will be our best opportunity yet to gather feedback on Setback. Head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/rtEg52gVzc]Discord[/url] and let us know what were doing right and what you think needs to be improved or implemented.

Our Setbots are now used as bots that will fill the missing amount of players during matches.
We will have a variety of rotating maps during Steam Next Fest. Some new, some updated.
Use your hard earned Setbucks to purchase a wide variety of cosmetics.

notes.title: August Playtest Full Devlog: Portals, Climbing, New items
notes.content:
[h1]Public Playtest![/h1]
[i]Friday, Friday, Friday![/i]

On Friday, August 12 at 19:00 (CEST) Setback returns with a new public playtest.

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/setback]Twitter[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/CUcehS3TvH]Discord[/url] to stay up to date.

[h1]New Movement Mechanic: Ledge Climbing[/h1]
Movement is the most important aspect of Setback, so naturally we are constantly looking at ways to improve this mechanic. Our latest update is ledge climbing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/cfba3d4ac45b0b574e5219b9f54efb098a66ede3.png[/img]

[h1]Portals[/h1]
Why did we add portals, of all things?

"Because some [i]guy[/i] in my friend group started up a discussion on the physics of moving portals, so I immediately implemented portals into Setback to test it out. You're welcome."
-Oliver


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/3456983bba7c8ec65143f592ea0d35658a0f267a.png[/img]

[h1]New Items: EMP & Bubble Shield[/h1]
The Bubble Shield is a defensive item that blocks incoming damage. The shield can block a total of 100 damage, but it also slowly drains over time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/9c55238b73c474589300975bb89cf439b2f25f7e.png[/img]

The EMP drains your enemies' ammo and items, giving you the advantage by leaving the opposition helpless.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/f2cc1b54923ea667c1567ff3f95b005b8972c098.png[/img]

Looking forward to play with you all on Friday!

notes.title: Summer Playtest Full Devlog
notes.content:
[h1]Public Playtest![/h1]
[i]Friday, Friday, Friday![/i]

On Friday the First of July at 7:30pm CEST Setback kicks off the summer with a new public playtest.

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/setback]Twitter[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/CUcehS3TvH]Discord[/url] to stay up to date.

[h1]New Map Location: Peony[/h1]
Setback's Stadium has been a staple of the game since we first started development. But there's no limits to the aesthetics we want to explore. This update we introduce you to one of our new work in progress environments that we currently just refer to as Peony.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/4045ed9bad435062bfd5a3bd050d0aa42b691ed5.png[/img]

[h1]Sound[/h1]
The absolute silliest thing about Setback's development is without a doubt the fact that we just never got around to implement sound. Well that has finally changed! We have now started the work on implementing audio. It will be very rough for this first iteration, with many WIP and placeholder sounds, but you will be able to hear the action at last!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/98f1842d1f7500b812e272e7063f27dff8e804e5.png[/img]

[h1]Emotes[/h1]
Data from previous tests have shown us that Setback players are simply too civil and polite. To combat this we've added the ability to emote, and ideally, taunt your opponent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/591c71fcd146916a92f16dea5b1a57ad5f9e6057.png[/img]

[h1]Various Improvements and Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] In bomb tag, the carrier now receives an adrenaline buff, giving the player more speed, health and melee range. This should make games of bomb tag more hectic.
[*] A new bomb distribution mode with a shrinking sphere (instead of expanding), kinda like the storm in Fortnite.
[*] An eyewear slot has been added to customization. Glasses no longer override hats.
[*] A whole bunch of effects broke when upgrading to Unreal Engine 5. These effects have now been fixed, resulting in a more responsive experience.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41498594/218cd16a20f4826b3a11a5982e8b07042bf67d1e.png[/img]

notes.title: Spring Playtest Full Devlog
notes.content:
[h1]Public Playtest![/h1]
Setback returns next Friday for a new public playtest!

Join us June 3. at 6 pm CEST, for Setback’s Unreal Engine 5 debut. Where you’ll be testing bugs, our new server backend, and a ton of new features!

Join our discord to stay up to date: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/CUcehS3TvH]Setback Discord[/url]

[h1]TAG! The bomb is yours![/h1]
In the new game mode bomb tag, you have to run, gun, and flee to make sure you're not left with the bomb when it blows. When the bomb goes off, anyone caught in the blast will be elminimated. Elude the bomb, and become the last man running!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653416/5198bd304f30bc9a5dbf1573aea40a2d4b7c6a81.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
We have a number of gameplay updates for the upcoming playtest!

At the center of important gameplay changes for this playtest is the ability to sprint. In most shooters sprinting comes with the trade-off of not being able to shoot while running. We didn't want this for Setback, so instead, we've implemented a stamina system. Setback has a range of mechanics for maintaining momentum, so a lot of depth will come from how you invest stamina to build speed, and then apply your skill to maintain it.

In addition to this, we’ve done some light weapon re-balancing in response to feedback from the last playtest. We have also made a small, yet significant change to how melee bouncing works. From now on, all bounce forces will have an up-ward bias, allowing you to effectively use it as a wall jump, for expanded mobility options. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653416/a7df0d563a14fd0117bf9d53480e6527fe744068.gif[/img]

[h1]New Main Menu[/h1]
Every game needs a main menu, and with this update we’re introducing a first look at what Setback’s main menu might end up looking like.

Look forward to more sub-menus being unlocked as development progresses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653416/886af73a71d0c564160d6adbff162b083268ea8c.png[/img]

[h1]New Customization Options[/h1]
Find your drip in Setback’s latest public playtest!

While we’re still in the early stages of preparing Setback’s full customization system, we’ve prepared an expanded roster of customization options for you to play with in the meantime. This includes a small selection of hats we’re preparing for the finished game, a ton of test hats, and a bunch of color options for Setbot. For now, all customization options will be unlocked by default. This will not be the case in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653416/9e44385d7e73700832a3f16f9eb4cd9cba30b571.png[/img]

[h1]Four New Items![/h1]
For setback’s latest playtest the Flashback, Molotime Cocktail, Splatbomb, and Gravity Wave items will be added to Setback’s combat sandbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653416/01f655d7d33645d5898d924afaf20265e6bf3f82.png[/img]

[h1]New Stages[/h1]
We’ve recently added a dedicated level designer to our team, so as a result, we have multiple new stage prototypes for you to playtest. A big step forward from using the one test map for a whole year, like we used to do. Progress!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653416/50de8e9f835de288db2b26933d0b559762b2bf1f.png[/img]
